changelog:
## v1.9.34

- Shipping Card Defaults: Shipping method cards now have default margin of 0 and default border radius of 4px
- Bundle Product Image Improvements: Image sizing uses aspect-ratio (1:1 square default, with custom options), and image hover scale distortion has been completely removed
- Responsive Bundle Layout Selection: Bundle layout is now fully responsive with device-specific selection (Desktop, Laptop/Tablet, and Mobile) supporting Grid and List layouts
- Clean Horizontal List Layout: Mobile list layout preserves strict horizontal orientation with left image and right content, preventing vertical collapsing
